explanation: Copy the original matrix, then assign destination (r,c) from original (n-1-c,r). Write into existing rows so the matrix and row objects retain their identities.
timeComplexity: O(n²) time for an n-by-n matrix.
spaceComplexity: O(n²) auxiliary space for the original-value copy.
